deals.evidence: which owns approximately 88% of the Club’s parent entity, West Bromwich Albion Group Limited
deals.headline: Guochuan Lai's Yunyi Guokai completes purchase of West Bromwich Albion
deals.investor: Yunyi Guokai (Shanghai) Sports Development Limited (Guochuan Lai)
deals.summary: Jeremy Peace sold West Bromwich Albion Holdings Limited, which owned approximately 88% of West Bromwich Albion Group Limited, to Yunyi Guokai (Shanghai) Sports Development, controlled by Guochuan Lai and funded with Palm Eco-Town and funds introduced by Yunyi Investment, an asset manager. Agreed 24 June 2016, completed September 2016; price not stated by the club.

deals.evidence: West Bromwich Albion Group Limited has secured a £20million loan from MSD UK Holdings Limited.
deals.headline: WBA Group secures £20m four-year loan from MSD
deals.summary: Four-year loan secured against all Group assets to fund the club's general operations, taken under Guochuan Lai's ownership; Bilkul later took on the interest and the club says the balance will be repaid by December 2026.

deals.evidence: West Bromwich Albion Group Limited has secured additional funding from MSD UK Holdings Limited.
deals.headline: WBA Group increases MSD loan
deals.summary: Additional MSD funding on top of the December 2022 £20m loan to provide working capital while Guochuan Lai sought a buyer; the increase was not quantified.

deals.evidence: has acquired an 87.8% shareholding in West Bromwich Albion Group Limited
deals.headline: Bilkul Football WBA completes West Bromwich Albion takeover
deals.investor: Bilkul Football WBA, LLC (Shilen Patel and Dr Kiran C. Patel)
deals.summary: Bilkul, ultimately owned by Shilen Patel and his father Dr Kiran C. Patel, acquired 87.8% of West Bromwich Albion Group Limited after EFL approval; price not disclosed. Shilen Patel became chairman.

deals.headline: Owner injects £17.6m of capital
deals.summary: Bilkul provided operating monies and capital injections of £17.6m in the year to 30 June 2025 (2024: £8.7m), taking its holding of Group to 93.9%.

name: West Bromwich Albion Football Club
notes: Revenue (£30.4m) is total 'Sales' in the summary cashflow statement the club published with Group's 2024/25 accounts; statutory turnover is in the full Group accounts on Companies House (07230595, filed 29 Mar 2026), which are a scanned PDF with no text layer. The club summary reports a Group loss and a net operating loss of £17m each but does not label it pre-tax, so pretax_result is null. No net-debt figure is published; the MSD loan (secured on Group assets and The Hawthorns freehold) is to be repaid by December 2026 and Bilkul has borne its interest (£5.2m recharged) since the takeover. PSC register for Group (07230595) names Shilen Patel (75% or more) since 28 February 2024. No chief executive is listed in the club directory (Mark Miles is Executive Director). The club received a two-point EFL deduction in 2025/26 for a £1.97m P&S breach. No Forbes/Sportico valuation; no dated follower counts found.

ownership_summary: West Bromwich Albion Football Club Limited is wholly owned by West Bromwich Albion Group Limited, 93.9% of which is held by Bilkul Football WBA, LLC, a vehicle ultimately owned by Florida-based investor Shilen Patel (the club's chairman) and his father Dr Kiran C. Patel. Bilkul bought 87.8% of Group from Guochuan Lai's Yunyi Guokai in February 2024 and has since raised its holding through capital injections; the remaining shares are held by minority shareholders not named by the club.
